_comment: Who and what the self-hosted mac runner accepts. docs/plans/42_self_hosted_mac_runner_plan.md sections 3.6 and 3.7. Three consumers: the controller streams this file into every job VM for the admission hook (hook_events, push_refs, actors; never policy_only_actors); github/apply-policy.sh writes the repository's workflow execution policy from it (policy_events, actors and policy_only_actors); and the mac and Windows routers send a run by, or a pull request authored by, a policy_only_actors login or any [bot] login not in actors, and any run of a head_prefix branch, to vendor runners. IDs are what count; logins are notes, except that a re-run's triggering actor is only known by login.

policy_only_actors.note: version updates (#1564): its runs, and any run of its branches, may start, route to vendor runners, and neither the hook nor the home host admits them

candidates.note: Codex; move to actors when it opens PRs under its own identity
